claims.wording: The TSC2026 abstract reports an excess of above-chance receivers in 100 screened Mind-to-Mind dyads relative to a binomial null model.
claims.outcome_definition: Reported count of receivers meeting a task-performance criterion versus a binomial expectation; not an overall hit rate and not 100 successful pairs.
supporting_observations: The conference entry reports a positive result without numerical test details.
competing_explanations: A reproducible task effect is a candidate interpretation; the abstract does not identify its cause.
Selection, dependence, criterion choice or ordinary information leakage require evaluation; none is established here.
missing_evidence: Successful-receiver count, per-receiver trials, null success probability, threshold, test direction, exact p-value and uncertainty are absent from the inspected abstract.
Complete protocol, preregistration, randomization/blinding logs, exclusions, multiplicity handling and attrition are needed.
No participant-level Mind2Mind dataset or executable analysis was obtained. Independent replication and a systematic contrary-evidence search are pending.
Independent human source verification and methodological review remain pending.

missing_evidence: Full questionnaire, response-rate details, weighting and item-level tables need inspection.
